> **Decoupled report.** Reads the outputs of [bin/run_validate_thetaphi.py](../bin/run_validate_thetaphi.py)
> from [runs/validate_thetaphi/](../runs/validate_thetaphi/). 15 configurations
> at the same locked parameters (NA = 39, t_oxide = 0.9 µm, β = 2°,
> oxide = HS_caliente, A₂ = 0.30 µm, φ₂ = π/2), varying only (θ, φ_exp).
>
> If χ²_red is roughly homogeneous across the (θ, φ) cells, the locked
> universal Tier-1 result generalises. If one cell dominates the χ², we
> have a structural angular issue.

# 1. Load results

```{python}
#| label: load
import sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path("./lib")))
import sweep_runner as sr
import plot_helpers
plot_helpers._ensure_latex_rcparams()

OUT          = Path("./sweep/runs/validate_thetaphi")
results_csv  = OUT / "results.csv"
decision_txt = OUT / "decision.txt"
traces_dir   = OUT / "traces"

assert results_csv.exists(), f"Run `python sweep/bin/run_validate_thetaphi.py` first."
df = pd.read_csv(results_csv).sort_values(["theta_exp_deg", "phi_exp_deg"]).reset_index(drop=True)

print(f"{len(df)} cells loaded")
df[["theta_exp_deg", "phi_exp_deg", "phi_sim_deg",
    "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"]].round(3)
```

# 2. χ²_red over the (θ, φ) grid

```{python}
#| label: heatmap
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4.5), constrained_layout=True)

# χ² heatmap (linear scale — they may all be O(100), so linear is more legible than log)
piv = df.pivot(index="theta_exp_deg", columns="phi_exp_deg", values="Rdet_chi2_red")
im = ax[0].imshow(piv.values, aspect="auto", origin="lower", cmap="viridis_r")
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(piv.columns))); ax[0].set_xticklabels([f"{p:g}°" for p in piv.columns])
ax[0].set_yticks(range(len(piv.index)));   ax[0].set_yticklabels([f"{t:g}°" for t in piv.index])
ax[0].set_xlabel(r"$\varphi_{\mathrm{exp}}$"); ax[0].set_ylabel(r"$\theta$")
ax[0].set_title(r"$\chi^2_{\mathrm{red}}(R_{\mathrm{det}})$ across $(\theta, \varphi_{\mathrm{exp}})$")
plt.colorbar(im, ax=ax[0], label=r"$\chi^2_{\mathrm{red}}$")
# annotate cells
for i, t in enumerate(piv.index):
    for j, p in enumerate(piv.columns):
        v = piv.values[i, j]
        ax[0].text(j, i, f"{v:.0f}", ha="center", va="center",
                   color="white" if v > piv.values.mean() else "black", fontsize=9)

# Pearson r heatmap
piv_r = df.pivot(index="theta_exp_deg", columns="phi_exp_deg", values="Rdet_pearson_r")
im2 = ax[1].imshow(piv_r.values, aspect="auto", origin="lower", cmap="viridis", vmin=0.5, vmax=1.0)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(piv_r.columns))); ax[1].set_xticklabels([f"{p:g}°" for p in piv_r.columns])
ax[1].set_yticks(range(len(piv_r.index)));   ax[1].set_yticklabels([f"{t:g}°" for t in piv_r.index])
ax[1].set_xlabel(r"$\varphi_{\mathrm{exp}}$"); ax[1].set_ylabel(r"$\theta$")
ax[1].set_title("Pearson r")
plt.colorbar(im2, ax=ax[1], label="r")
for i, t in enumerate(piv_r.index):
    for j, p in enumerate(piv_r.columns):
        v = piv_r.values[i, j]
        ax[1].text(j, i, f"{v:.2f}", ha="center", va="center",
                   color="white" if v < 0.85 else "black", fontsize=9)

plt.show()
```

# 3. Aggregate statistics

```{python}
#| label: stats
print(f"χ²_red — sum    : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].sum():8.2f}")
print(f"        — mean   : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].mean():8.2f}")
print(f"        — median : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].median():8.2f}")
print(f"        — min    : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].min():8.2f}  (best cell)")
print(f"        — max    : {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].max():8.2f}  (worst cell)")
print(f"        — max/min: {df['Rdet_chi2_red'].max() / df['Rdet_chi2_red'].min():.2f}")
print()
print("Best 3 cells:")
print(df.nsmallest(3, "Rdet_chi2_red")[
    ["theta_exp_deg", "phi_exp_deg", "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"]
].round(3).to_string(index=False))
print()
print("Worst 3 cells:")
print(df.nlargest(3, "Rdet_chi2_red")[
    ["theta_exp_deg", "phi_exp_deg", "Rdet_chi2_red", "Rdet_RMSE", "Rdet_pearson_r"]
].round(3).to_string(index=False))
```

# 4. Best cell — full comparison plot

```{python}
#| label: best-cell

best = df.loc[df["Rdet_chi2_red"].idxmin()]
phi_sim_best = sr.SimConfig(
    period_um=12.9, A_um=1.5, t_oxide_um=0.9, oxide_dispersion="HS_caliente",
    theta_deg=float(best["theta_exp_deg"]),
    phi_sim_deg=float(best["phi_sim_deg"]),
    harmonics=39, slices=50, beta_deg=2.0,
    A2_um=0.30, phi2_rad=float(np.pi/2),
    wavelengths_um=np.arange(3.0, 25.0, 0.25),
).filename_stem()
best_avg_path = traces_dir / phi_sim_best / f"AVG_{phi_sim_best}.csv"

EXP_DIR = Path("../data/experimental")
phi_str_map = {0: "0", 22.5: "22-5", 45: "45", 67.5: "67-5", 90: "90"}
phi_str = phi_str_map[float(best["phi_exp_deg"])]
exp_paths = sorted(EXP_DIR.glob(f"12-3_{int(best['theta_exp_deg'])}_{phi_str}_*.CSV"))

fig, ax = plot_helpers.plot_comparison_with_residual(
    sim_avg_path  = best_avg_path,
    exp_paths     = exp_paths,
    observable    = "R_det",
    sample_label  = "12-3",
    theta_exp_deg = float(best["theta_exp_deg"]),
    phi_exp_deg   = float(best["phi_exp_deg"]),
    beta_deg      = 2.0,
    figsize       = (8, 7),
    title         = (rf"Best cell: $\theta={best['theta_exp_deg']:g}^{{\circ}}$, "
                     rf"$\varphi_{{\mathrm{{exp}}}}={best['phi_exp_deg']:g}^{{\circ}}$, "
                     rf"$\chi^2_{{\mathrm{{red}}}}={best['Rdet_chi2_red']:.1f}$"),
)
plt.show()
```

# 7. Verdict

```{python}
#| label: verdict
ratio = df["Rdet_chi2_red"].max() / df["Rdet_chi2_red"].min()

print(f"χ²_red max/min ratio = {ratio:.2f}")
if ratio < 2.0:
    print("\n✓ Roughly homogeneous across (θ, φ_exp). The locked configuration generalises.")
    print("  The remaining ~100 χ²_red is the same structural residual seen at (30°, 0°),")
    print("  pointing to the Cr2O3 phonon model. Stage 2 / 3 can proceed without a fundamental")
    print("  angular structural fix.")
elif ratio < 5.0:
    print("\n◌ Moderate angular variation. The locked configuration is approximately right")
    print("  but not perfectly uniform. Worth examining the worst cell's residual shape")
    print("  before committing to materials work.")
else:
    print("\n✗ Strong angular dependence — one or more (θ, φ) cells fit dramatically worse.")
    print("  This is structural. Possible diagnoses:")
    print("    - φ_sim mapping `90° − φ_exp` is wrong for non-zero φ_exp")
    print("    - Geometric model (sinusoidal grating) is missing 2D structure visible at")
    print("      certain incidence angles")
    print("    - The β = 2° detector aperture is angle-dependent in the physical setup")
    print("  Resolve before attempting Cr2O3 phonon work.")
```
